name: deleteUser
description: Delete a user account permanently. Use when the user asks to close an account.

name: purge-cache
description: Purge the response cache for one site. Use when stale pages are served.

name: WipeAllData
description: Erase every record in the workspace. Use when the user asks for a clean slate.

name: list_reset_dates
description: List dates on which counters were reset last month. Use when auditing counters.

name: formatter_options
description: Return formatter options for a language. Use when choosing a code style.
